interpretation: descriptive conditional results on selected historical dates; not full market coverage or evidence of a live trading edge

metric_definitions.aggregation: never sum overlapping paths into a portfolio, select a winner, or annualize selected dates
metric_definitions.arithmetic: Decimal precision 60; exact money; ratios rounded half-even to 6 decimal places
metric_definitions.average_win_loss: mean net-positive episode P&L and mean net-negative episode P&L; null for empty group
metric_definitions.drawdown_exclusion: not intraday mark-to-market drawdown; no unobserved prices inferred
metric_definitions.entry_fill_rate_pct: 100 * confirmed buy shares / shares requested in submitted entry orders; null if no orders
metric_definitions.episode: one confirmed entry fill to flat; partial exits combined; re-entry is a new episode
metric_definitions.episode_fees: original causal incremental charges on entry and all its exits; fees subtracted once
metric_definitions.equity_curve: seed followed by all 30 flat session closes; nonconsecutive research dates
metric_definitions.expectancy_usd: mean net P&L per closed episode; null if no episodes
metric_definitions.max_drawdown: largest seed-or-session-close peak to later session-close decline; USD and percent computed separately
metric_definitions.net_pnl: confirmed sell proceeds minus confirmed buy costs minus all original incremental fees
metric_definitions.population: all original 12 alternative paths, each with all 30 selected dates and once-only seed
metric_definitions.profit_factor: sum positive episode NET P&L / abs(sum negative episode NET P&L); null if no losses
metric_definitions.return_pct: 100 * net P&L / original account seed; not annualized
metric_definitions.win_rate_pct: 100 * net-positive closed episodes / all closed episodes including flats; null if no episodes
